text: Once upon a time there was a small village at the edge of a great forest, and the people who lived there worked hard every single day, gathering wood and growing vegetables and trading with travellers who came along the old road from the mountains, bringing news of distant cities and strange inventions that nobody in the village had ever seen before, and every evening the children would gather around the fire to listen to these stories until the stars came out and their parents called them home to sleep.
